legend.maritime.plaNote1: When several days are overlaid, older ones are fainter and newer ones brighter; darker overlaps mean more frequent activity
legend.maritime.plaNote2: Drawn from Ministry of National Defense schematic maps; not precise flight paths
legend.maritime.vwNote1: Thin lines are trails (AIS sampled roughly every 15 minutes, so not continuous tracks)
legend.maritime.vwNote2: Classes are inferred from vessel name / MMSI rules; most warships are foreign vessels in transit (Chinese and Taiwanese navy ships mostly stay AIS-silent)
legend.maritime.aisRow: AIS reports in the last 30 minutes
legend.maritime.aisNote: Live positions; per-vessel trails are not connected yet
legend.maritime.presRow: Historical snapshot; does not represent the latest release
legend.maritime.presNote: For the latest dates, refer to the hourly Grid / Tracks / SAR layers; this layer is not live AIS.
legend.maritime.gridNote1: Color scale = vessels per 0.1° grid cell; opacity varies continuously with vessel count
legend.maritime.gridNote2: Switches by UTC hour following the global timeline
legend.maritime.gridOutOfWindow: ⚠ The current time is outside the data window; the layer has faded out
legend.maritime.tracksNote1: Thin line of the same color = trail; dot of the same color = vessel position at the selected time (linearly interpolated between observations)
legend.maritime.tracksNote2: Lines approximate the centers of hourly GFW HIGH grid cells and are not precise raw AIS tracks. Interpolation happens only within the same segment; signal gaps and abnormal jumps are not bridged across segments. Endpoints at the same coordinates are aggregated and sized by vessel count.
legend.maritime.tracksNote3: Source is the production schema-4 day pack; Tanker is not part of this layer's taxonomy, and GEAR/FAD are separate non-vessel observations.
legend.maritime.tracksOutOfWindow: ⚠ {date} is outside the data window, so the layer is intentionally blank
legend.maritime.hourUnavailable: ⚠ No data for the selected vessel types at this hour
legend.maritime.effDay: Timeline UTC day: {date} · log1p(apparent fishing hours)
legend.maritime.effFacets: Aggregation facets: each cell keeps its component facets (see popup)
legend.maritime.effNote: Each day is an independent sample; apparent / model-derived, not real time; not catch volume, vessel counts, enforcement evidence, or an illegal-fishing determination.
legend.maritime.darkTitle: GFW SAR detections unmatched to AIS
legend.maritime.darkRow: Dot size = SAR detections in the same cell
legend.maritime.darkNote: Points are GFW HIGH grid cell centers. "Unmatched to AIS" does not mean illegal or a dark vessel, and cannot confirm that a vessel deliberately turned off AIS.
legend.maritime.moNoteCwa: Central Weather Administration fixed stations | Updated about hourly; freshness uses CWA-specific thresholds
legend.maritime.moNoteIsohe: Harbor environment information network fixed stations | Updated about every 10 minutes; freshness uses ISOHE-specific thresholds
legend.maritime.moNote2: Point color shows only station freshness / source status, not any metric; check the vertical datum before comparing tide levels.
legend.maritime.trashNote1: Point density reflects Mapillary street-view coverage, not the actual distribution of trash
legend.maritime.coralLine: Warm-water coral reefs, historical distribution · v4.1 (released 2021-03)
legend.maritime.coralNote1: Historical baseline; not current health, live coral cover, or bleaching.
legend.maritime.coralNote2: Visibility loss at low zoom and missing coverage both do not mean there is no coral; this version has no coverage for Matsu.
legend.maritime.coralNote3: Taiwan is only a study window, not an administrative boundary; areas are for the full global source features and must not be summed.
legend.maritime.allenAcquired: Acquired on {date} (not the observation date); the full source feature area is not clipped and cannot be used as the study-area total.
legend.maritime.gbMpaWales: Wales: not covered (no open layer for Skomer MCZ)
legend.maritime.gbMpaHpma: England's Highly Protected Marine Areas: licence unconfirmed, not included
legend.maritime.gbMpaSacSpa: SACs/SPAs with marine parts are in the "Protected Areas" layer
legend.maritime.gbMpaNav: Not to be used for navigation
